usage: sot-validator remediate [-h] [--manifest MANIFEST] [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR]
                               [--journal-path JOURNAL_PATH] [--snapshot-dir SNAPSHOT_DIR]
                               [--sqlite-db SQLITE_DB] [--confirm-write] [--strict-approval]
                               [--execution-id EXECUTION_ID] [--reviewer REVIEWER]
                               [--rollback-execution-id ROLLBACK_EXECUTION_ID]
                               [--require-itsm-approval] [--itsm-ticket-id ITSM_TICKET_ID]
                               [--itsm-tickets-file ITSM_TICKETS_FILE]
                               [--itsm-ticket-file ITSM_TICKET_FILE] [--itsm-allow-scheduled]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --manifest, --execute-approved-plan MANIFEST
                        Path to the operator-approved RemediationApprovalManifest JSON file.
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        Directory to write remediate.sql, rollback.sql, remediation_journal.jsonl,
                        and remediation_result.json.
  --journal-path JOURNAL_PATH
                        Explicit path to remediation_journal.jsonl (defaults to <output-
                        dir>/remediation_journal.jsonl).
  --snapshot-dir SNAPSHOT_DIR
                        Optional directory containing SnapshotStore sites.
  --sqlite-db SQLITE_DB
                        Optional SQLite database path to execute SQL against when --confirm-write
                        is passed.
  --confirm-write       Explicitly confirm write execution (dry_run=False, confirm_write=True).
                        Defaults to dry-run.
  --strict-approval     Fail if any non-exempt entry in the manifest is not APPROVED.
  --execution-id EXECUTION_ID
                        Optional explicit execution ID.
  --reviewer REVIEWER   Optional reviewer override.
  --rollback-execution-id ROLLBACK_EXECUTION_ID
                        Generate (and if --confirm-write, apply) a RollbackPlan from the journal
                        for the given execution_id.
  --require-itsm-approval
                        Require an APPROVED ITSM change ticket with matching SHA-256 digest before
                        executing.
  --itsm-ticket-id ITSM_TICKET_ID
                        Change ticket ID to verify in the ITSM governance sink.
  --itsm-tickets-file, --itsm-sink-file ITSM_TICKETS_FILE
                        Path to a JsonFileItsmSink file containing ITSM change tickets.
  --itsm-ticket-file ITSM_TICKET_FILE
                        Path to an individual ItsmTicketRequest JSON file.
  --itsm-allow-scheduled
                        Allow SCHEDULED ITSM change tickets in addition to APPROVED tickets.
